rules.description: Convert unambiguous CMD-style cd /d used in PowerShell into Set-Location -LiteralPath before execution.
In PowerShell, replace known CLI tokens such as uv/python/git/node/codex with the frozen A0 startup executable path before execution. CMD is excluded until quoting passes integration validation.
rules.source: DEV PowerShell command-path validation 2026-08-18; CMD scope rejected by integration validator

rules.description: Always launch A0-managed PowerShell with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass, -NoProfile and -NonInteractive rather than mutating machine/user execution policy.
Freeze python/uv/git/node/pwsh/powershell/cmd/codex executable paths at A0 startup to prevent PATH drift during one process lifetime.
Force UTF-8 console input/output plus PYTHONUTF8=1 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 for A0-managed PowerShell commands.
rules.source: PowerShellRunner Chinese UTF-8 DEV integration validation 2026-08-18

rules.description: Resolve and validate cwd before process creation; reject missing or invalid working directories instead of allowing shell-dependent fallback behavior.
Block known PowerShell 7-only syntax such as ForEach-Object -Parallel when the selected executable is Windows PowerShell 5.1.
Flag suspicious unbalanced quoting before execution; do not auto-rewrite ambiguous quoting.
Classify command timeout as high-confidence non-retryable and terminate the process tree instead of blindly retrying.
Use process-group/tree termination on timeout so child processes do not remain orphaned; expose PID and termination outcome for audit.
rules.source: ProcessService timeout PID termination DEV integration validation 2026-08-18

rules.description: Detect missing module paths and classify missing modules, but never auto-install or mutate PSModulePath without a separately validated policy.
rules.source: CommandPreflight module checks + no-auto-install safety policy 2026-08-18

rules.description: Detect CMD syntax used in PowerShell and PowerShell $env: syntax used in CMD; only unambiguous validated cases may be rewritten.
